name: h37rv
key_challenge: Very high GC (~65.6%), PE/PPE and PE_PGRS repeat gene families

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 100 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz
simulation.notes: Higher coverage for small genome. GC-bias error model in dwgsim is relevant here.

truth.simulated: dwgsim read name encodes true origin coordinates; evaluate with paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: Partition accuracy by PE/PPE vs. non-PE/PPE regions for full diagnostic value. PE_PGRS families (tandem repeat-containing) are the primary repeat stress. Aligner divergence in PE/PPE loci is expected and informative.
